steps.welcome: Take a quick tour of Lettuce — we'll point out the main areas. You can skip anytime and replay it later.
steps.dashboard: Your Dashboard: see your managers, peers and (if you lead a team) your subordinates.
steps.dashboardManagers: My managers — the people you report to.
steps.dashboardPeers: My peers — teammates who share a manager with you.
steps.dashboardSubordinates: My subordinates — the people who report to you (if you lead a team).
steps.dashboardMyTeams: My teams — the teams you manage, each opening its own members view.
steps.feedback: Feedback: give, request and review feedback across the Received, Provided and My team tabs.
steps.feedbackReceived: Received — feedback others have given you.
steps.feedbackProvided: Provided — feedback you have given to others.
steps.feedbackTeam: My team — feedback across the teams you manage.
steps.kudos: Kudos — the public wall of appreciation: every public feedback from across the organization, newest first.
steps.oneOnOnes: 1:1 meetings — document the outcomes of one-on-ones between a manager and a direct report: points discussed, decisions made and action items. Open action items carry over to the next meeting.
steps.oneOnOneOwn: I'm a subordinate — the 1:1 meetings your manager holds with you.
steps.oneOnOneManaged: I'm a manager — the 1:1s you hold with your direct reports; new meetings start here.
steps.oneOnOneTeam: My subordinate's a manager — 1:1s held by the managers who report to you.
steps.myGoals: Goals — the goals you're involved in: as the person they're set for, and (for managers) as their author. Open a goal to see its details and history.
steps.goalsOwn: My goals — the goals your managers set for you, in one list across every manager.
steps.goalsManaged: Goals I've set — the goals you've set for your reports; the Reports filter can widen the list to goals set further down your chain.
steps.teamKpis: Team KPIs — the measurable indicators your teams track. Open a KPI to see its data points, a graph of its value over time, and its history.
steps.teamKpisOwn: My teams' KPIs — the active and archived KPIs of the teams you belong to.
steps.teamKpisManaged: KPIs I've set — the KPIs of the teams you manage, drafts included; new KPIs start here.
steps.performance: Performance — the performance reviews your manager published about you; managers get a second tab with their team's reviews.
steps.performanceOwn: My performance — every review published about you, period by period, with the ratings and summaries your manager wrote.
steps.performanceManaged: Team's performance — every subordinate's review for a picked period, with completion at a glance.
steps.daysOff: Days off — the team calendar, your requests and paid-days budget; managers also resolve their reports' requests here.
steps.daysOffCalendar: Calendar — who is away and when, month by month; weekends and public holidays are shaded so you can plan around them.
steps.daysOffRequests: My requests — your own days off: request new ones, follow their status, and track what is left of your budget.
steps.daysOffTeam: My team — the requests your direct reports have filed, where you accept or reject them.
steps.pulseSurvey: Current survey — the open cycle's questions. Your answers are anonymous, and you have to answer before you can see any results.
steps.pulseResults: Results — the anonymous eNPS and question scores of a closed cycle, shown only for groups big enough to keep answers unattributable.
steps.pulseParticipation: Participation — how many people in the teams you watch have answered. You see counts and names of who responded, never their answers.
steps.config: Config — users, teams, templates and the registries the rest of the app draws on.
steps.configUsers: Users — the people directory (admins manage accounts).
steps.configOrg: Org chart — the whole organization on one canvas: managers, their teams, and the members below, including members who manage teams of their own.
steps.configReviewPeriods: Review periods — the timeline of periods that performance reviews are written for. Everyone can read it; admins append the next period.
steps.configPublicHolidays: Public holidays — the non-working days that days-off requests are costed against. Everyone can read it; admins maintain it.
steps.configPulseCycles: Pulse cycles — schedule a pulse survey, open it, and close it when you have enough answers. You see participation counts here, never individual answers.
steps.configFeatureFlags: Feature flags — turn individual features on or off for a person, or for everyone matching a filter at once.
steps.configAlerts: Alerts — the announcement banners shown at the top of the app, each with its own visibility window.
steps.dictionaries: Dictionaries — the shared lists the rest of the app picks from: career paths, career specializations, seniority levels, and the pulse survey's rotating questions.
steps.notifications: Notifications: you'll be alerted here when feedback, 1:1 meetings, goals, team KPIs, performance reviews, or days off concern you — from a feedback request to an accepted leave.
steps.language: Switch the interface language (English / Polski) at any time.
steps.selfReflection: Self-reflection — write feedback about yourself. Once sent, your managers can read it.
steps.account: Your account — change your password here.
steps.changelog: Changelog — what's new in each release. A red dot on the version stamp below marks changes you haven't seen yet.
steps.logout: Your account menu: change your password or sign out when you're done.
steps.replay: That's it! Replay this tour anytime from here.
steps.pulse: Fill the recurring pulse survey here and explore your team's anonymous eNPS results once a cycle closes.
